record.paper_title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems
record.original_question: For the planar cubic rigid systems ẋ = −y + x(a + bx + cy + dx² + exy) and ẏ = x + y(a + bx + cy + dx² + exy), determine whether the maximum possible number of limit cycles is 2.

evidence.quote: Problem 1. Consider the family of planar cubic rigid systems{ ˙x =−y +x(a +bx +cy +dx2 +exy), ˙y = x +y(a +bx +cy +dx2 +exy). Is 2 its maximum number of limit cycles?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the family of planar polynomial differential systems
$$\dot x = -y + x\,(a + bx + cy + dx^2 + e xy), \qquad \dot y = x + y\,(a + bx + cy + dx^2 + e xy),$$
where $a,b,c,d,e \in \mathbb{R}$. Such a system is called a cubic rigid system because, in polar coordinates $(r,\theta)$ with $x=r\cos\theta$, $y=r\sin\theta$, one has $\dot\theta = 1$ identically. A limit cycle is an isolated periodic orbit of the system in the phase plane $\mathbb{R}^2$.

Determine whether the maximum number of limit cycles that any system in this family can have is exactly $2$. Equivalently, prove or disprove: for every choice of $(a,b,c,d,e)\in\mathbb{R}^5$, the system above has at most $2$ limit cycles, and this bound is attained.
artifact.category_tag: limit cycles of planar polynomial systems
artifact.status_search_result: Searches reveal related work on rigid cubic systems showing some sub-families have uniqueness of limit cycles while others can exhibit at least two limit cycles, but no source explicitly establishes (or disproves) the sharp upper bound of 2 for the full five-parameter family in question. The specific question of whether 2 is the maximum number of limit cycles for this family appears unresolved in the accessible literature.

status_evidence.title: Limit cycles for rigid cubic systems
status_evidence.snippet: Studies rigid cubic systems and their limit cycles, showing uniqueness for some families and at least two limit cycles for another sub-family.
status_evidence.claim: Related results bound or exhibit limit cycles for some rigid cubic sub-families but do not settle the sharp maximum for the stated five-parameter family.

status_evidence.title: Exact number of limit cycles for a family of rigid systems
status_evidence.snippet: Determines the exact number of limit cycles for certain rigid families.
status_evidence.claim: Exact bounds are known only for specific rigid families, not the general cubic rigid family with five parameters a,b,c,d,e.
